QuestInfo.name: Knights of Virtue - Day Ten
QuestInfo.0: Use a Virtue's Blessing skills at least once a day to be counted for participation. Today is the final day of participation! Your gift is waiting!
QuestInfo.1: Use a Virtue's Blessing skills at least once a day to be counted for participation. Today is the final day of participation! Your gift is waiting!
QuestInfo.2: For truth and justice! For virtue! The battle wages on!

0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k. I see you've wielded your Stone of Virtue well for all 10 days that I've been watching. I'm impressed, and I'd like to give you a gift. Would you like it now?

no.0: You can wait if you want to, but I really think you're missing out!

yes.0: #b#i1022137# #t1022137# x 1#k\n\nHere's a little something for your efforts, but it doesn't mean you'll stop trying, right? Thanks for keeping Maple World safe, #h0#. Oops, I mean, Knight of Virtue.

default.0: Double-check to make sure you've used the Knights of Virtue icon to activate the stone's power for 10 days. Check the Attendance Book in the Event list.
